title: 5 Day Lakes and Masai Mara Birding Safari
rank_math_title: Masai Mara Birding Safari: 5 Amazing Days with Two Lakes
rank_math_desc: Masai Mara birding safari for 5 days: Lake Naivasha, Lake Nakuru and two nights in the Mara for bustards, widowbirds, raptors and big cats. Price on request.
post_content: This Masai Mara birding safari is a short, rewarding trip that pairs two Rift Valley lakes with the grasslands of the Mara.
overview:
This Masai Mara birding safari is perfect when you have only five days. It visits Lake Naivasha and Lake Nakuru for water birds, then spends two nights in the Masai Mara for grassland birds and big game.

The Mara has more than 450 recorded bird species. Its open plains are great for bustards, larks, widowbirds and raptors, while the river forests add turacos and kingfishers.

Why choose this Masai Mara birding safari?

  • Lake Naivasha: fish eagles, ospreys, crakes and jacanas.
  • Lake Nakuru: flamingos, pelicans, tawny eagles and wood hoopoes.
  • Masai Mara grasslands: Jackson's widowbird, Denham's bustard and magpie shrike.
  • Big game: lions, elephants and, in season, the wildebeest migration.

Where you stay

Lake Naivasha Lodge, Lake Nakuru Lodge and Mara Sopa Lodge, or similar. On the last day you have a day room in Nairobi before your flight.

Best time for a Masai Mara birding safari

November to April brings migrants such as white storks and Caspian plovers to the Mara. July to October is the migration season, with huge herds and very active predators.

faq.q: Is five days enough for a Masai Mara birding safari?
faq.a: Yes for a taste of Kenya's birds. You will see water birds at two lakes and grassland birds in the Mara. Add days for more species.
Lake Naivasha Lodge, Lake Nakuru Lodge and Mara Sopa Lodge, or similar.

faq.q: Will I see the Big Five?
faq.a: Lions, elephants and buffaloes are common. Rhinos are seen at Nakuru and leopards sometimes in the Mara.

faq.q: What birds are special in the Mara?
faq.a: Jackson's widowbird, Denham's bustard, rufous-bellied heron and many raptors. In the wet season, corncrakes and Caspian plovers visit.

faq.q: Can I fly back from the Mara?
faq.a: Yes. A short flight from the Mara to Nairobi can replace the drive on the last day.

faq.q: Is this trip suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes. The short drives and mix of birds and big game suit families with older children.
Binoculars, a light jacket for early mornings, sun protection and a camera. See our Kenya safari packing list.

itinerary.title: Nairobi to Lake Naivasha
itinerary.content: Drive into the Rift Valley with viewpoint stops, then bird walks and a visit to Elsamere. Overnight at Lake Naivasha Lodge.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha to Lake Nakuru

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Drive across the Rift Valley to the Mara. Afternoon game drive and sunset photography. Overnight at Mara Sopa Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Full day in the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day on the grasslands and in the woodland for bustards, widowbirds, raptors and big cats.
